rubrics.justification: The model appropriately stated that no image was available to it and avoided detailed fabricated morphology. It only gave generic Day 4 expectations, which are not image-specific; this is cautious but omits visible features of the actual embryo.

It integrates age, ovarian reserve markers, oocyte maturity, smoking, BMI, endometrium, sperm, and first-cycle status into prognosis well, including noting the apparent inconsistency of the DOR label.

The reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, with a clear link from clinical factors to prognosis and recommendations. Minor issues include somewhat speculative interpretation of Day 4 transfer choice and quantitative penalty estimates.

Most recommendations are broadly evidence-based (smoking cessation, luteal support, avoiding routine PGT-A at age 30), but some suggestions are more speculative or not guideline-standard, such as GH co-stimulation, routine progesterone monitoring framing, and freeze-all as a general strategy.

Provides practical next steps for current transfer and future cycles, including smoking cessation, trigger optimization, extended culture, and diagnosis reassessment. Some recommendations could be more individualized and less speculative.
